test_title: PYST 4: DP Head Constable (AWO/TPO) 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 28 Oct 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: There are five friends Annie, Babila, Charu, Diksha, Era. Annie is taller than Babila but not taller than Charu. Charu and Diksha are of the same height. Annie is shorter than Era. Who is shortest amongst all?
solution:
Given that there are five friends: Annie, Babila, Charu, Diksha, and Era.

Annie is taller than Babila but not taller than Charu

Annie > Babila

This means Annie is shorter than or equal to Charu: Charu ≥ Annie.

Charu and Diksha are of the same height

Charu = Diksha

Annie is shorter than Era<
